configuration.declaration_status: computational specification saved before Monte Carlo; not public preregistration
configuration.input_law: iid N(0,1) coordinates, independent between channels and splits
configuration.noise_law: iid N(0,0.03^2) coordinates, independent between channels and splits
configuration.planning_rule: first tested positive delta with empirical rejection rate >= 0.95; no interpolation
configuration.alternative: H_c(delta)=H_c0+delta*lambda*U_c*D_c; D_c iid N(0,1) in R^(2x3)
configuration.alternative_basis: first two left singular vectors of H_c0; each column sign fixed by its largest absolute entry
configuration.alternative_scope: rank-2 local blocks, fixed channel ranges, ensemble-specific; delta is not distance to entire null family
configuration.alternative_draw_frequency: fresh directions each replicate; kernels held fixed between calibration and heldout splits
configuration.shared_test_fit: unconstrained OLS of each 3x3 readable block on heldout probes, with exact conditional covariance
configuration.shared_test_scope: common-compatible shared sector only; no full global rank-2 adequacy or physical ECL test
configuration.calibration_predictive_diagnostic: 19-parameter common-compatible quotient vs 27-parameter independent readable blocks; descriptive only
configuration.interval_scope: pointwise 95% Wilson intervals conditional on frozen MC threshold; not simultaneous or threshold-uncertainty intervals
configuration.map_draw_order: ambient output basis, ambient input basis; then output and input 6x3 isometries for each channel
configuration.replicate_draw_order: local D if applicable; X_cal; noise_cal; X_test; noise_test

rank_2_invisible_witness.alteration: add 0.37 times declared sixth output basis vector to first left factor column
